diagnosis: The billing route in Fastify relies on a request decorator customerAccount attached by a global plugin wrapped in fastify-plugin. The hook sets the account strictly from request.query.accountId without comparing it to the authenticated caller's account ID. Any authenticated user can view itemized tax invoices, billing addresses, and payment records of any customer account by setting the accountId query parameter.
exploit_request:
GET /api/billing/invoices?accountId=acc_enterprise_fortune500 HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.cloudservices.net:8093
